detailed_description: Typing Time Calculator estimates how long it will take to type a document based on word count and typing speed. Enter your text or word count, select your typing speed in words per minute (WPM), and get accurate time estimates. The tool includes preset speeds for different skill levels from beginner to professional typist. Perfect for writers planning their work sessions, students estimating assignment completion time, or anyone curious about typing productivity. Also useful for transcription time estimates.
usage_steps: Enter word count or paste text
